title: Getting dressed
notes: Each arc says what has to go on first: undershorts (Und) before pants, socks (Sox) before shoes, shirt (Shi) before tie. The watch (Wat) depends on nothing and nothing depends on it, so it can go anywhere.
ops: Und>Pan, Und>Sho, Pan>Sho, Pan>Blt, Shi>Blt, Shi>Tie, Tie>Jkt, Blt>Jkt, Sox>Sho, Wat
